title: A penalised Saito functional for heuristic search of free line arrangements
summary: We introduce the penalised Saito functional $\mathfrak S_{λ,β}(\mathcal{A};d_1,d_2)$ for a reduced arrangement $\mathcal{A}$ of $n$ lines and a prescribed pair $d_1+d_2=n-1$. It measures the alignment of a candidate Saito determinant with the defining polynomial while penalising the failure of the candidate derivations to be logarithmic. We prove that the functional takes values in $[0,1]$, vanishes exactly when $\mathcal{A}$ is free with exponents $(1,d_1,d_2)$, and lies strictly between $0$ and $1$ otherwise.
